metadata.name: EDH User
metadata.description: Self-service EDH GPU workstations: launch, list, connect to, stop, start, renew the lease on and delete your own workstations, browse the image catalog and instance types and read the lease policy, call the login-profile and secure-config routes the web app and CLI use at sign-in, and read the route listing the web app uses to decide which actions to offer. Ownership of a workstation is enforced by the service from the session record, not by these constraints. Templates create constraints only: create the role first (POST /roles or `vamscli role create`; mfaRequired is a role attribute chosen there), import this template with variableValues.ROLE_NAME, then assign users. When narrowing edhImageId, edhOsFamily or edhInstanceType, use equals or starts_with; is_one_of is a substring test on these string fields.

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-web-routes
constraints.description: Allow navigation to the EDH workstations page for {{ROLE_NAME}}

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-api-routes-get
constraints.description: Allow GET on the workstation and catalog routes, the sign-in probes (login profile, secure config) and the route listing for {{ROLE_NAME}}

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-api-routes-post
constraints.description: Allow POST for workstation launch, stop, start and lease renewal, and the login-profile write at sign-in, for {{ROLE_NAME}}

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-api-routes-delete
constraints.description: Allow DELETE of workstations for {{ROLE_NAME}} (own sessions only; ownership is enforced by the service)

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-workstations
constraints.description: Allow launch, view, stop, start, renew, connect and delete of workstations on any image, OS family and instance type for {{ROLE_NAME}}; ownership is enforced by the service

constraints.name: {{ROLE_NAME}}-catalog-images
constraints.description: Allow viewing every catalog image for {{ROLE_NAME}}
